props.title: Technical Specifications
props.description: The walnut wood card tray is precision milled to perfectly fit a stack of Focus cards. The powder coated steel divider separates active cards from new ones, or can be used to archive important task lists.

features.description: Solid walnut base with rare earth magnets and powder coated steel card cover
Hand sanded and finished with natural oil
Wood card tray and 3 refill packs
Made from natural materials. Grain and color vary with each item.
